description: This file defines the PermissionService class, which provides methods for validating permissions, matching permission patterns, and retrieving permission data from a permission registry.

classes.name: PermissionService
classes.description: A service class for managing and validating permissions, including pattern matching and retrieval functions.

methods.name: validatePermission
methods.description: Validates a single permission string against the permission registry.

methods.name: validatePermissions
methods.description: Validates a list of permission strings, returning the first invalid result.

methods.name: permissionMatches
methods.description: Checks if a permission pattern matches a given permission, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: getAllPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves all permissions from the permission registry with descriptions and categories.

methods.name: getPermissionsByResource
methods.description: Retrieves permissions associated with a specific resource.

methods.name: getPermissionsByCategory
methods.description: Retrieves permissions belonging to a specific category.

methods.name: getPermissionCategories
methods.description: Returns a list of all unique permission categories.

methods.name: getPermissionsByAction
methods.description: Retrieves permissions associated with a specific action.
